Container.Name: narrator
Container.Overview: Turns stories into audiobooks read by a cast of expressive voices. Upload a story and your own Ollama works out who says each line and how they feel. Chatterbox, running on your NVIDIA GPU inside this container, acts each line out in that character's voice, and can copy a voice from a short clip. Your Kokoro-FastAPI can be used for fast voices and as a fallback. Whisper listens back to every line and re-renders any that come out garbled. You get an M4B audiobook with chapters, or an MP3. Listen to every voice and pick your cast in the web UI. Needs the Nvidia Driver plugin. Free forever: no paid tiers, no Pro account, no subscriptions.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Narrator web UI

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, your voices, stories, finished audiobooks and the downloaded voice models (about 4 GB, downloaded the first time a voice is used)

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU to use. 'all', or your GPU's UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin page if you have more than one.

Config.Name: Ollama address
Config.Description: Optional. Your Ollama, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434. It works out who says each line and how they feel. Without it, speakers are guessed from the text. Can also be set later in the web UI.

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: The Ollama model to use. Pull it in Ollama first (ollama pull qwen2.5:7b).

Config.Name: Kokoro address
Config.Description: Optional. Your Kokoro-FastAPI, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8880. Its voices appear in the web UI next to the Chatterbox ones.

Config.Name: Whisper check
Config.Description: builtin (listens back on the CPU inside this container), external (your whisper-asr-webservice, set its address in the web UI) or off

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: Optional. Ask for this password in the browser and the API (any user name).
